title: Hatsune Miku — Brand New Wonderland〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks for coming, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay☆ It's Miku and KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for the invite! It seems you have a special show in store?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. That's right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're not gonna believe this!
It's a show where you all play a part too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You mean to say it's an interactive performance? I'd love to hear more.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. You'll be joining Meekoo's Party of Adventurers to help hunt for the “Wish-Granting Treasure”.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Meekoo will need all the help you can give her since the Treasure can only be found after solving some puzzles.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, Miku!
What's the Wish-Granting Treasure?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe. Well now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It never ever breaks or stops being shiny!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It never breaks or stops shining?
Like a diamond?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But, is there anything like that in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll learn what the Treasure is during the course of the show. Without further ado, shall we get set up?

rows.Speaker: Mayor Kayeeto
rows.Line:
“Take care, adventurers!
May your journey be a safe one!”

rows.Speaker: Adventuress Meekoo
rows.Line: “We'll be sure to find the Wish-Granting Treasure!”

rows.Speaker: Adventuress Meekoo
rows.Line:
“Here we go, everyone!
Let's start by solving the prancing ponies puzzle!”

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene, Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line:
Okay!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Thus began the arduous journey of Meekoo and her trusty companions.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, Luka? When did you get here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehehe. I'm the narrator!
So I'll be following you and narrating what you do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
By the way, Meekoo.
A moment ago, you said that we need to solve the “prancing ponies puzzle”. What is that?

rows.Speaker: Adventuress Meekoo
rows.Line: “So, in order to find the Wish-Granting Treasure, we apparently need to first find the Four Hidden Treasures!”

rows.Speaker: Adventuress Meekoo
rows.Line: “There's the Mane of Faith, the Paintbrush of Dreams, the Drum of Courage and the Banner of Wisdom!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A mane and a paintbrush?
That's quite an eclectic mix of treasures...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah. What could they all be?

rows.Speaker: Adventuress Meekoo
rows.Line: “It'll all make sense when we solve the riddles! Let's keep going!”

rows.Speaker: Treasure Guardian Lenne
rows.Line: “You who have solved our riddles, behold our final task! You must find the Mane of Faith among the horses on this carousel!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The riddles before this must have been clues! Let's see... The answers were “star”, “sibling” and “piano”...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's it!
Look at that small horse above that drawing of piano keys. It's the horse nuzzling up to it with a star on its forehead!

rows.Speaker: Treasure Guardian Lenne
rows.Line: “Correct! The Mane of Faith is yours.”

rows.Speaker: Treasure Guardian Rinne
rows.Line:
“Wah...!
I have never seen such a strange creature! Such imagination makes you worthy of the Brush of Dreams.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo♪
I won something just for drawing☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It really is an incredible picture.
Especially this animal with plants growing out of it! There are hermit crabs in real life that attach anemones to themselves, so if we were to consider actual examples in nature—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui, we get it. Let's get moving.

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Meekoo and her party were happily collecting the Hidden Treasures, until two of the group were snatched away by a giant bird!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mother Hen Mayeeko
rows.Line: “My oh my, just look at those delicious snacks on legs♪ My chicks will eat well tonight, oh ho ho!”

rows.Speaker: Emu & Rui's Voices
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Adventuress Meekoo
rows.Line: “Oh no! Emu! Rui!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Those two enjoyed getting snatched away far too much...

rows.Speaker: Adventuress Meekoo
rows.Line:
“Turn right at that corner!
You're halfway to the end!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ngh... It's so hard to go through a maze blindfolded.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Especially with all these obstacles—
Eep! Wh-Why is the ground suddenly so bumpy?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ignore it, it's just a foot massage mat! Keep going!

rows.Speaker: Mother Hen Mayeeko
rows.Line: “Now I won't need to worry about my chicks falling out of my nest! You humans really are clever♪ Please accept this token of my gratitude!”

rows.Speaker: Mother Hen Mayeeko
rows.Line: “I believe it's called...the Banner of Wisdom.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, we've been looking for that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. Let's take this unexpected loot back to Meekoo and the others.

rows.Speaker: Adventuress Meekoo
rows.Line: “The Four Hidden Treasures led us to this location! Now all we have to do is find the Treasure Sage.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But, isn't this the village we started from?
There's a sage here...?

rows.Speaker: Mayor Kayeeto
rows.Line: “You've returned safely, I see.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Mr. Mayor! Yes, we're back!
And we brought the Hidden Treasures!

rows.Speaker: Mayor Kayeeto
rows.Line:
“I knew you had it in you.
The time has come for me to reveal myself.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you don't mean...

rows.Speaker: Sage Kayeeto
rows.Line: “The sage who guards the secret of the treasure was I all along.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You were right under our noses the whole time!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? You guard “the secret of the treasure”? Not the treasure itself?

rows.Speaker: Sage Kayeeto
rows.Line: “Do you remember what kind of treasure the Wish-Granting Treasure is?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
It never ever breaks or stops being shiny!

rows.Speaker: Sage Kayeeto
rows.Line: “Correct. The truth is, that treasure is already in your possession.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! But we never found anything other than the Four Hidden Treasures...

rows.Speaker: Sage Kayeeto
rows.Line: “Hehe. The real treasure is the bonds the four of you have forged amongst yourselves.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our bonds...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: With those strong bonds, nothing can stop you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You have bonds with us, too☆
Hip hip hooray!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Hip hip hooray!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Rui, Emu & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hip hip hooray!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku, how was it putting on a different show than usual? Did you have fun?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup, I sure did♪
I have to thank MEIKO later for suggesting it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, did you have fun too, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I did. My part wasn't until the finale, so I got to secretly watch your adventure from afar.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?! I didn't notice!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ooh, in that case, I want to be the secret watcher next time we do this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Next time, huh?
I suppose it does seem a shame to end things here. Maybe we can invite the plushies for round two.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!
